senses.gloss: áya, a. subst. going, a going. [√i, 1148. 1a b.]

áyana, n. a going; place of going, way;
course; esp. course (of the sun from one
solstice to the other), i. e. half-year. [√i,
1150. 1a.]

áyas, n. metal; iron. [cf. Old Lat. ais,
gen. ais-is, Lat. aes, ‘metal, bronze’; AS.
ār, ‘bronze,’ Eng. ore; perhaps AS. īsern,
īren, Eng. iron, ‘ferrum, ferreous^1.’]
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210219. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/52.

āyátana, n. foot-hold; resting-place; esp.
place of the sacred fire, fire-place. [√yat
+ ā.]

ā́yata-locana, a. having long eyes.
[√yam + ā.]

āyasá, a. metallic, of iron; as n. metal,
iron. [áyas, 1208a.]

āyāma, m. like Eng. extent, i. e. length.
[√yam + ā, ‘extend.’]
